Third-party provenance and local changes — 2026-11-10
====================================================

libwing 1.0.6
https://github.com/dannyfiresnake/libwing
Source archive revision: 36d713e (archive root dannyfiresnake-libwing-36d713e).
The repository LICENSE contains Apache License 2.0. Cargo.toml declares MIT.
Upstream metadata is retained in the private development tree; this distribution
preserves the actual license text without rewriting the upstream discrepancy.
The actual LICENSE is also copied to libwing-LICENSE.txt and licenses\libwing.

Files changed locally:
  src/ffi.rs       Added wing_console_toggle (documented native wToggleToken),
                  wa_clone, wa_shutdown, wa_read_json and wa_release_meter
                  C ABI functions.
                  JSON conversion delegates to the existing node serializer;
                  definition events include parent_id for path reconstruction.
  libwing.h        Synchronized added declarations, size_t include, and actual
                  meter-read signature (upstream had an unused extra argument).
  src/console.rs   Native integer toggle encoding (0xD8);
                  TCP connection/write timeouts (three seconds);
                  last-owner-only stream shutdown on Drop;
                  explicit shutdown; Windows TimedOut handling; extended descriptor
                  length handling with a size bound; escaped numeric payloads;
                  escaped meter port/report identifiers; meter read timeout return;
                  malformed/truncated meter packet, source-IP and full-report-ID checks;
                  active meter report tracking/release without ID reuse; UDP socket
                  reads outside the parameter mutex with a 100 ms timeout.
                  Widened 256-byte string / 65536-index length arithmetic;
                  rejected oversized strings before native encoding.
  Cargo.toml       Retained runtime library dependencies, omitted GUI example/dev
                  dependencies for this library-only build.
  Cargo.lock       Updated for the library dependency set.

The native protocol implementation was reused, not replaced with a fresh parser.
The generated src/propmap.rs was not hand-edited. data\demo.jsonl originates from
the upstream Compact firmware 3.0.5 propmap.jsonl, expanded with the pinned
3.1.2 protocol/editor data described in data/schema-version.json. Vendor binaries and protocol/manual documents are not bundled. References are
linked from the user guide's Credits chapter.

The dependency lockfile is retained in private development records. License texts
collected from the actual installed crate sources are in
licenses\<crate-version>. These include runtime and build/procedural-macro crates.
Rust's distributed copyright/third-party notices and its bundled runtime notices
are preserved under licenses\rust-runtime. License collection retains filenames
and original text instead of substituting a generic dependency license summary.

No azaosc, MXAccess32, WING firmware image, manual PDF or WingEmul binary is bundled.
